description: Negative rejection fixture: delta_text (field 3) contains bytes [0x08, 0x80, 0x01], which parse as a valid protobuf submessage (field 1 = varint 128) but constitute malformed UTF-8 (0x80 is an invalid UTF-8 byte). Demonstrates that decoders must not use parse-success heuristics to bypass UTF-8 string validation.

provenance.note: Negative fixture demonstrating rejection of invalid UTF-8 strings that syntactically mimic valid protobuf submessages.
